preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (0xBd51b6D98574327734C1621A7283778c5e6Af86e)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable token swapping and liquidity additions. This will stop all automated liquidity provision and token-to-ETH swaps, effectively freezing transaction functionality for regular users while the owner remains unaffected.
